is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates Anopheles gambiae s.l. (specifically An. coluzzii and An. gambiae sensu stricto) in Cameroon (page 1, Abstract; page 6, Molecular speciation).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study genotypes the kdr L1014F (Vgsc L995F) mutation and the Ace-1 G119S (Ace-1 G280S) mutation (page 5, 'Detection of the kdr west (1014F) mutation' and 'Detection of the Ace-1 gene (G119S) mutation').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Genotype counts and proportions are reported in Table 1 (Prevalence of Ace-1 and Kdr variants in An. gambiae s.l from Edea and Buea, n=135 for Kdr, n=106 for Ace-1), Table 2 (broken down by species and locality), and Table 3 (broken down by phenotypic resistance status).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquito larvae were sampled across eight communities in Buea and Edea in Cameroon between June 2022 and March 2023 and reared to adulthood (page 3, 'Sampling sites and larva rearing').

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article presenting empirical field bioassay and genotyping results.

sub_country_location.evidence: Larvae were collected in Buea (Checkpoint Molyko, Dirty South, Mile 16, Muea) and Edea (Eboga, Ekite, Mangombe, Nkoua) in Cameroon (page 3, 'Sampling sites and larva rearing').

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito larvae were collected 'during the periods of June 2022 to March 2023' (page 3, 'Sampling sites and larva rearing').

duplicate_risk.evidence: The mosquito collections were newly and routinely conducted by the authors in 2022–2023 with no indication of reuse from other published datasets.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and phenotypic bioassay data are fully reported in the main manuscript text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated insecticide susceptibility and target-site resistance markers (kdr L1014F and Ace-1 G119S) in Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles coluzzii collected as larvae from Buea and Edea in the forest zone of Cameroon between June 2022 and March 2023. Extractable genotype counts across sites and resistance phenotypes are presented.
